title: P1 claim: request
description: The worker asks for work with long waiting. What to give out is decided by the core dispatcher by the closed list of conditions dispatch-predicates.yaml and the order keys (DSP-2). There is no "give me this task" or "this worker" field; the worker does not pass owner (DSP-4, DSP-10).

kinds.description: Work kinds that the worker is ready to take; erasure is a step of an erasure or match request for edge stores (E1, E2, E4, E5).

wait_s.description: Long-poll waiting time; the binding sets the upper bound.
